answer.origin: finance.yahoo.com article dated 2026-07-01, reporting an NN, Inc. announcement made in late June 2026 (no exact day given). The article is a secondary media report; no primary NN release was supplied.
answer.note: NN, Inc. reportedly announced in late June 2026 that it is adding 47 machine centers at its Wuxi, China plant for liquid cooling production for 'NVIDIA AI data center racks'. The company stated that 100% of the new capacity is already pre-sold under multi-year, multi-product awards and targets US$80–US$90 million of accretive new business in 2026. For NVIDIA, this is a supply-chain lead rather than a disclosed NVIDIA order: it suggests that liquid cooling content for NVIDIA-platform AI racks is being contracted at tier-2 suppliers in Asia with multi-year visibility. Conditional on the awards being for NVIDIA-platform racks, this points to firm downstream demand for NVIDIA rack systems into the coming years. Hypothesis not established: that NVIDIA is the direct purchaser of this capacity or that the awards originate from NVIDIA rather than from rack integrators or other OEMs. The US$80–US$90 million figure is a company target, not a reported result, and should not be read as NVIDIA-related revenue. The analyst revenue and earnings projections for NN and the Russell Microcap index removal concern NN, not NVIDIA, and carry no weight for this NVIDIA research note.
limitations: The customer or buyer of the pre-sold awards is not identified in the source; it is unknown whether NVIDIA is a direct customer, a rack integrator is, or another OEM is.
The 100% pre-sold claim and the multi-year, multi-product award terms are company statements as relayed by a media outlet; no contract values, durations, or signing dates were supplied.
The US$80–US$90 million 2026 target is NN's own business target; its timing, share attributable to this Wuxi expansion, and share attributable to NVIDIA-related racks are not disclosed.
No NVIDIA-side confirmation of NN as a supplier, nor any NVIDIA disclosure of liquid cooling supplier concentration, was supplied.
The exact announcement day within late June 2026 is not given, and the original NN release was not supplied.
follow_up: Retrieve NN's original late-June 2026 press release or SEC filing and check whether it names NVIDIA or a rack integrator as the awarding customer for the pre-sold capacity.
Check NVIDIA's latest 10-K and supplier disclosures for any named liquid cooling or thermal suppliers, and whether any single supplier is material to purchase obligations.
Compare the Wuxi machine-center installation and ramp timeline with announced NVIDIA rack or platform ramp schedules to see whether the capacity timing matches NVIDIA-linked demand.
Check whether NN's 2026 business target and any subsequent quarterly results report revenue from the Wuxi expansion, to test whether the pre-sold claim translated into realized orders.
